event_time_rules.event_date: position start date/month for entry or transition
event_time_rules.same_month_precision: flag interval ambiguity; do not use evidence that cannot be ordered before the event
event_time_rules.ongoing_prior_job: truncate at event time for duration accumulation
event_time_rules.education: count only credentials completed or known to be in progress by event time

duration_rules.general_work: union all observable pre-event employment intervals
duration_rules.occupation_task: union pre-event intervals mapped to the same occupation family or supported related-task family
duration_rules.industry_domain: union pre-event intervals carrying the same industry/domain mapping
duration_rules.specific_tool: union only intervals with time-stamped, position-linked tool evidence
duration_rules.overlapping_jobs: take the union of intervals within each dimension; never sum overlapping calendar time twice
duration_rules.internships: calculate separately and exclude from non-internship totals unless a later specification explicitly combines them
duration_rules.left_censoring: retain observed lower-bound duration and a censoring flag; never encode unobserved prior history as zero

common_support.unit: employer x occupation_family x region x calendar_quarter
common_support.linkup_side: eligible deduplicated JOB_HASH/URL records with a mapped common cell
common_support.revelio_side: eligible person entry/transition events with a mapped common cell
common_support.use: align aggregate distributions and define overlap; do not assert advertisement-to-hire linkage
common_support.unmapped: retain in source-specific coverage tables and exclude from common-cell contrasts
common_support.support_thresholds: not set until actual Revelio coverage is profiled; do not invent numeric thresholds
common_support.time_gate: Calendar-quarter matching is structural only while LinkUp text is delivery_snapshot_only. Do not treat CREATED as requirement time or correlate it with same-quarter hires as contemporaneous demand. Historical demand-flow contrasts require independent text-time evidence.

denominators.event_population: all observed events satisfying the event definition before experience-object classification
denominators.mapped_common_cell: event population with employer, occupation family, region, and quarter all mapped
denominators.experience_object: mapped events with adequate pre-event observation; include verified zero only when history is not left-censored and evidence coverage is adequate
denominators.unknown_or_censored: separate denominator category, never folded into zero experience
denominators.multiple_objects: multi-label; object shares need not sum to 100 percent
